<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.

Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

Padded eager prefill can fail with the `tilelang` and `triton` DSA sub-backends. Their sparse kernels return `[1, N, H, Dv]`, but attention padding restoration identifies token rows on dimension 0. The extra batch axis can prevent output padding from being restored, causing a subsequent TP reduce-scatter shape error.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Remove the internal singleton batch axis at the `tilelang` and `triton` adapter exits, preserving token-first outputs across prefill and decode. Raw kernel interfaces and numerical computation remain unchanged.
- Extend the existing padding regression to cover both backends, including single-query and non-TP-aligned inputs.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

- CPU regressions: **12 passed**, with **17 subtests passed**. The four added subcases fail before the fix and pass afterward; the standard CI entry point also passes.
- `triton` standalone checks on H200, with BF16/FP8 KV and 1/34/36 queries: valid outputs are bitwise unchanged, padding rows are zero, and prefill CUDA Graph replay matches eager execution.
- GLM-5.3-Flash, TileLang, 4 × H200: GSM8K, **1,314 examples × 2 runs: 96.0%, 95.9%**. End-to-end validation includes #46225 to address an independent KDA/GDN padding issue; this DSA layout fix does not depend on that change.

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_dsa_backend_dp_padding.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/test_radix_attention_padded_extend.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

N/A — correctness fix using view-only layout normalization.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+                    self._check_sparse_prefill_padding(implementation, real_rows)
+
+    def _check_sparse_prefill_padding(self, implementation, real_rows):
+        rows = (real_rows + 3) // 4 * 4
+        q = torch.arange(rows * 2 * 3, dtype=torch.float32).view(rows, 2, 3)
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            layer_id=0,
+            head_dim=3,
+            qk_head_dim=3,
+            v_head_dim=2,
+            tp_q_head_num=2,
+            is_cross_attention=False,
+            scaling=1.0,
+        )
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+            out_cache_loc=torch.arange(rows),
+            positions=torch.arange(rows),
+            mha_return_lse=False,
+            _attn_output=None,
+        )
+        values = torch.arange(real_rows * 2 * 2, dtype=torch.float32).view(
+            1, real_rows, 2, 2
+        )
+        kernel = ModuleType(
+            "sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsa."
+            + (
+                "tilelang_kernel"
+                if implementation == "tilelang"
+                else "triton_sparse_mla"
+            )
+        )
+
+        def fake_sparse_fwd(**kwargs):
+            query = kwargs.get("q", kwargs.get("q_nope"))
+            self.assertEqual(query.shape[0], real_rows)
+            return values
+
+        setattr(
+            kernel,
+            "tilelang_sparse_fwd"
+            if implementation == "tilelang"
+            else "triton_sparse_mla_fwd",
+            fake_sparse_fwd,
+        )
+        backend = SimpleNamespace(
+            dsa_prefill_impl=implementation,
+            use_mha=False,
+            use_fused_topk=True,
+            hisparse_coordinator=None,
+            dsa_index_kpool=1,
+            forward_metadata=SimpleNamespace(max_seq_len_k=64),
+            token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(
+                get_key_buffer=lambda _: torch.zeros(64, 1, 3),
+                set_mla_kv_buffer=lambda *args: None,
+            ),
+            _resolve_kpool_tail_backend=lambda indices, impl: impl,
+            _check_kpool_tail_backend=lambda *args: None,
+            get_topk_transform_method=lambda _: TopkTransformMethod.PAGED,
+            _pad_topk_indices=lambda indices, n: indices[:n],
+            _get_fused_topk_page_table=lambda indices: indices,
+        )
+        backend._forward_tilelang = MethodType(
+            DeepseekSparseAttnBackend._forward_tilelang, backend
+        )
+        backend.forward = MethodType(DeepseekSparseAttnBackend.forward_extend, backend)
+        with (
+            patch.dict("sys.modules", {kernel.__name__: kernel}),
+            patch.object(graph_utils, "get_attn_backend", return_value=backend),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa_backend.concat_mla_absorb_q_general",
+                side_effect=lambda q, rope: torch.cat((q, rope), dim=-1),
+            ),

+            output = graph_utils._attention_on_real_rows(
